text: {"hierarchy":6,"layout_spacing":5,"typography":5,"color_contrast":6,"consistency":5,"overall":5,"reason":"The bold red NEWS and orange SPORT headlines draw attention, but the cramped placement of the 7:00 time block and MOS TV text near the ball, plus the cut-off edges and an embedded note asking for a 10/10 rating, weaken the layout and make the design feel unpolished."}
